chapter.verse: Vanpi zalin, leitung piangsak a, mihingte tungah nuntakna a pia Topa in Israel mite tawh kisai-in thu gen a,
“Leenggahzu bangin Jerusalem khuapi ka bawl ding a, a kiim-a om minam dangte in a nek ciangin khamin hoi ding uh hi. Jerusalem khuapi a umcih uh ciangin Judah gam khuapi dangte zong umcih ding uh hi.

Tua hun hong tun’ ciangin suangtumpi gik mahmah bangin Jerusalem khuapi ka bawl ding a, liik khiat a sawm minam khatpeuh peuh in liamlawh ding hi. Leitung minam dang khempeuh kipawlin Jerusalem sim ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin a sakolte uh ka lausak ding a, a sakol tung tuangte uh ka haisak ding hi. Ahi zongin Judah mite ka kem ding a, a galte uh’ sakolte, a mit ka tawsak ding hi.
Tua ciangin Judah minamte in, ‘Jerusalem-a a teeng mite, Vanglianpen Topa ahi amau’ Pasian’ hangin thahat uh hi,’ ci ding uh hi.

Tua ni ciangin, Judah minamte, tulak kang leh buhphal kang ka bangsak ding a, a kiim-a om minam dangte khempeuh susia ding uh hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem mite a khuapi sungah lungmuangin om hithiat ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah galkapte tungah gualzawhna ka pia masa ding a, David’ suan-le-khakte leh Jerusalem khuamite’ minthan’na in Judah mi dangte’ minthan’na sangin lianzaw tuan lo ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin Jerusalem-a teeng mite, Topa in hu ding a, a gina lo pente nangawn, David zahin thahat ding hi. David’ suan-le-khakte in Topa ’ vantungmi bangin ahi zongin Pasian mahmah bangin ahi zongin amaute makaih ding uh hi.
Jerusalem sim ding a hanciam minam khempeuh, tua ni ciangin ka susia ding hi.

David’ suan-le-khakte leh Jerusalem khuamite tungah, hehpihna leh thunget nopna lungsim ka guan ding hi. Amaute in a sut lup uh mipa enin, ta khat neihsun a sihsuahte bangin kap ding uh a, a tacil a khuaisuahte bangin nakpi takin kapin thuum ding uh hi.
Tua hun lai takin Jerusalem khua sunga kap-a thuumna in, Megiddo zanglei-a Hadadrimmon pasian’ sihna hangin kahna leh thuumna zah mahin nasia ding hi.

Gam sung khempeuh ah a innkuan kuanin dahin kap ding uh hi. David’ suan-le-khakte sung panin a innkuan kuanin kapin, a zite uh zong a tuam mahin kap ding uh hi. Nathan’ suan-le-khakte zong a innkuan kuanin kapin, a zite uh zong a tuam mahin kap ding uh hi.
Levi’ suan-le-khakte leh a zite, Shimei’ suan-le-khakte leh a zite,
leh beh dang khempeuhte zong a behbehin, a zite uh tawh a tuam ciatin kapin thuum ding uh hi.
